name: the-sessions-own-project-still-judges-a-command-naming-an-installation
description: T506, the other direction and the one that proves nothing was loosened: the SAME command naming the SAME installed tree, from a session whose own project IS armed and carries no ledger. Dropping the installation removes a judge that came from a shipped file; it does not excuse the command. The refusal is the session's own project's - which is also why the audit line lands here, in $PROJECT: while the installation still governed, the tie went to the target's project and the line was filed inside the plugin cache instead.
